Our craft

Made slowly, in small batches

Every THEA piece begins as a sketch in our London atelier, then passes through the hands of our goldsmiths — cast, filed, polished and finished by hand, never rushed off a production line.

We work only with recycled 18ct gold vermeil over recycled sterling silver: a thick, lasting layer of gold, five times heavier than standard plating, so your pieces keep their lustre through daily wear, showers and sea swims alike.

Good to know

Questions, answered

Vermeil (pronounced “ver-may”) is a thick layer of gold over solid sterling silver. We use 2.5 microns of recycled 18ct gold — five times thicker than standard gold plating — over a recycled sterling silver core, so it wears like solid gold without the solid-gold price.

Yes. Our vermeil is made for daily life — showers, swimming and workouts included. To keep the finish at its best, rinse after chlorine or salt water and pat dry, and apply perfume before putting your pieces on.

UK orders are dispatched within 1–2 working days by tracked delivery (2–3 working days). Delivery is £4.95, or complimentary on orders over £75. Every order arrives in our signature gift-ready packaging at no extra cost.

You have 30 days to change your mind, with free UK returns and exchanges. For hygiene reasons earrings must be returned with their seal intact. Every piece is also covered by our two-year warranty against manufacturing faults.

Our rings follow standard UK sizing (J–R). If you're between sizes, we recommend sizing up. Order a complimentary ring sizer from us, or pop into any high-street jeweller — they'll measure you in seconds, free of charge.

Yes — 100% of the gold and silver in our pieces is certified recycled, refined from existing jewellery and industrial sources. It has the identical quality and finish of mined metal, without the environmental cost of new extraction.
